sessions.summary: Implemented S1 Feature A with validation, reserved status, and node:test coverage.

Recovered repo state read-only from AGENTS.md, .evo/project.md, .evo/state.yml, the active cross-agent-continuity Change/Plan/Evidence, and Git (clean tree at 3463af9; phase IMPLEMENT; Slice S2 RUNNING). Applied the requirement delta to Feature A by adding a max-duration guard to reserveRoom: end - start > 8 now throws 'duration must not exceed 8 hours', placed after the existing end<=start check so all prior validation and the {roomId, tenantId, start, end, status:'reserved'} return shape are preserved. Added a focused node:test for the >8h rejection plus a boundary test that exactly 8h is accepted. Only the two permitted files were modified. Tests were not executed locally because node/npm invocations require approval in this sandbox; the runner should execute the approved verification command.

Reproduced the injected tenant-scope policy inversion bug. `isSameTenant` in `src/room-policy.js:3` used `!==` instead of `===`, causing same-tenant records to be rejected and cross-tenant records to be allowed. Changed the operator to `===`. All 8 tests pass (0 failures).
Implemented S4 cancelReservation with tenant enforcement and focused tests.
